title: Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish lamb stew made with tender lamb, potatoes, carrots, and Guinness stout.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Look for lamb with a good layer of fat

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the bacon to the pot and cook until crispy. Remove from pot and set aside with the lamb.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Guinness stout, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb and bacon to the pot. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
